title: SpaCE: a spatial counterfactual explainable deep learning model for predicting out-of-hospital cardiac arrest survival outcome
summary: SpaCE uses explainable deep learning and spatial counterfactuals to predict out-of-hospital cardiac-arrest survival from EMS/community data.
